## EXECUTION PATHS

### The Blitz (V1)
- **Speed:** Fast. Personal + Business credit. Max extraction now.
- **Risk:** One shot. 6-24 month cooldown if it doesn't work.
- **Cash needed:** None.
- **Sub-paths:**
  - V1a: Personal + Business (max extraction)
  - V1b: Business only (preserves future personal eligibility)

### The Prime Protocol (V2, RECOMMENDED)
- **Speed:** 90-120 days. Business credit only.
- **Risk:** Multi-round. Repeatable every 1 week to 1 month.
- **Cash needed:** $5-10K+ in business bank accounts.
- **Compounds:** Can reach $500K+ through multiple rounds.

## 6-TIER ASCENSION MODEL

| Tier | Offer | Price | Key Details |
|------|-------|-------|-------------|
| 0a | DIY Credit Optimization | $47-97/mo or $997 | Entry-level. Self-serve education. |
| 0b | DFY Funding ONLY | $0-2K upfront + 10% fees | No education. Slower. Client just wants funding done. |
| 1 | Trial | ~$750 | Delivers fundability assessment + approx funding range (no bank names/data points). |
| 2 | DWY Program (THE course) | $5K-$15K | Core offer. Full course access. Done-With-You. |
| 3 | DWY + DFY Ascended | $10K-$30K | Course + hands-on DFY elements. |
| 4 | Full White Glove | $15K-$35K | Complete DFY. Premium. Everything done for client. |

**Ascension works BOTH directions:** Ascend up (0a→4) AND downsell down (4→0a). Sales call = doctor: qualify → prescribe ONE tier → downsell if needed. Client never sees all 6 options.
